title: Tech reimbursement form
summary: Tech reimbursement claims: one row per claim with claim date, employee, item, category, amount in rupees and status.

category.meaning: kind of expense: Connectivity, Hardware, Software or Supplies
category.label: Category

status.meaning: claim status: Approved, Paid, Pending or Rejected
status.label: Status

validations.message: amount is negative or implausibly large

questions.ask: Total Amount (INR) and number of claims with claim date between two dates (inclusive), for one or two statuses, with a per-status breakdown

status_2.description: a second status, e.g. Paid (leave empty for one status)

questions.sql: SELECT coalesce(status, 'TOTAL') AS status, count(*) AS claims, coalesce(sum(amount_inr), 0) AS total_inr FROM {{table}} WHERE claim_date BETWEEN {{start}} AND {{end}} AND (lower(status) = lower({{status_1}}) OR lower(status) = lower({{status_2}})) GROUP BY ROLLUP(status) ORDER BY status NULLS LAST

questions.ask: Which employees claimed the most Amount (INR) in one category (e.g. Hardware) with claim date between two dates (inclusive), ranked highest first with claim count; Rejected claims are left out

start.description: first claim date, inclusive (for 'this year', 1 Jan of the current year)

end.description: last claim date, inclusive (for 'this year', today)

questions.sql: SELECT employee, count(*) AS claims, sum(amount_inr) AS total_inr FROM {{table}} WHERE lower(category) = lower({{category}}) AND claim_date BETWEEN {{start}} AND {{end}} AND lower(coalesce(status, '')) <> 'rejected' GROUP BY employee ORDER BY total_inr DESC, employee

history.taught: total Amount (INR) between two claim dates for one or two statuses
rank employees by Amount (INR) claimed in a category between two dates, excluding Rejected
form fields: labels, measures, business rules (DGX migration to the form format)
